clips.send: In vertex form y equals a(x minus h) squared + k, the square vanishes at x equals h. Move h and k and compare the solid curve with the dashed reference y equals ax squared .
clips.text: In vertex form y = a(x − h)² + k, the square vanishes at x = h. Move h and k and compare the solid curve with the dashed reference y = ax².

clips.send: Find the allowed inputs first. If both endpoints are allowed, compare their outputs with the vertex’s output if the vertex is in the domain. If an endpoint is excluded, the function may approach an extreme value without ever reaching it. Use all 24 m of fencing on three sides of a rectangle beside a wall. Drag the point to change the depth x in meters and see how the area A in square meters changes. Open circles show the limits where no rectangle forms. A ball launches straight up from the ground at 20 m/s. The model ignores air resistance and rounds the acceleration due to gravity to 10 m/s squared . Drag the point or move the time slider to see the height H in meters at time t in seconds.

clips.send: A quadratic function has the form y equals ax squared + bx + c with a is not equal to 0. Its graph is a parabola. Change only c and watch the point on the y-axis. The two sides of the parabola mirror each other across its axis. When it opens up, y falls as x increases to the left of the vertex and rises to the right. When it opens down, the pattern reverses. Set x equals 0 to find the y-intercept. Solve y equals 0 to find the x-intercepts. Changing only c moves the whole graph up or down by the same amount.

Set x = 0 to find the y-intercept. Solve y = 0 to find the x-intercepts. Changing only c moves the whole graph up or down by the same amount.

clips.send: Read the vertex and check which way the graph opens. Then use the second marked point to check the value of a. Earn one point for each graph you match on your first try.

clips.send: 在顶点式 y等于a(x减h) 的平方加k 中，当 x等于h 时，平方项为零。改变 h 和 k，观察实线怎样从虚线 y等于ax 的平方 平移得到。
clips.text: 在顶点式 y＝a(x−h)²＋k 中，当 x＝h 时，平方项为零。改变 h 和 k，观察实线怎样从虚线 y＝ax² 平移得到。

clips.send: 形如 y等于ax 的平方加bx加c（a 不等于 0）的函数叫做二次函数，图象是一条抛物线。先只改变 c，观察哪个点始终在 y 轴上。抛物线关于对称轴成轴对称。开口向上时，顶点左侧的函数值随 x 增大而减小，右侧随 x 增大而增大。开口向下时，变化趋势相反。令 x等于0 得到与 y 轴的交点；令 y等于0 可求出与 x 轴交点的横坐标。只改变 c 时，所有函数值的变化量都相同，图象整体上下平移。

clips.send: 先确定自变量的取值范围。如果两个端点都允许取到，就把两个端点的函数值与范围内的顶点处的函数值比较。如果某个端点不在取值范围内，对应的极值可能取不到。用完 24 米围栏，靠墙围成一个长方形，只围三边。拖动图上的点，改变垂直于墙的边长 x（单位为米），观察面积 A（单位为平方米）怎样变化。空心点表示围不成长方形的边界。球从地面以 20 米／秒的初速度竖直向上抛出。模型忽略空气阻力，重力加速度取近似值 10 米／秒 的平方 。拖动图上的点或时间滑块，观察球在 t 秒时的高度 H（单位为米）。
